purpose: Test stock-selection and risk-reduction layers on top of C0. Retain C0 unless a layer improves NET risk-adjusted performance after realistic costs.

previously_tested_and_failed_not_reteste.idea: admit same-day candidates in momentum-rank order
previously_tested_and_failed_not_reteste.result: failed: Calmar 0.21 design / 0.42 hold-out vs baseline 0.67 / 0.42; CI includes zero
previously_tested_and_failed_not_reteste.live_default: display the rank only; allocation order stays C0's

previously_tested_and_failed_not_reteste.idea: halve risk when the Nifty is below its EMA200
previously_tested_and_failed_not_reteste.result: failed: Calmar 0.03 design / 0.29 hold-out; CI includes zero

execution_model: same as PREREG_v1 (itemised costs, 10 bps slippage, 5% volume and 2% ADV caps). Decisions use this model only.

windows.walk_forward_blocks: calendar years 2017-2024 by entry date; parameters are fixed, nothing is fitted
windows.holdout_rule: opened once per (hypothesis, prereg hash), only for variants that pass every walk-forward criterion; logged in experiments/holdout_log.jsonl
windows.contamination_note: The 2025+ window is also the hold-out of PREREG_v1; opening it for several families is a form of repeated looking, which is why the family below counts every test.

multiple_testing.note: Counting the earlier benchmark tests and the v1 family makes this deliberately harder to pass.

hypotheses.name: sector cap
hypotheses.change: at most 2 open positions per sector group (universe/sectors.json); a third same-sector entry is skipped

hypotheses.name: preferred-tier stack
hypotheses.change: keep only trades that meet ALL of: momentum rank in the top 30% of the universe, close within 10% of the 52-week high, 20-day average traded value >= INR 5 crore, ATR/close <= 4%, Nifty above its EMA200 on the signal date

hypotheses.name: volatility-scaled risk
hypotheses.change: risk 0.375% per trade (0.75x) when ATR/close > 4%, otherwise 0.5%; the open-risk cap is unchanged

walk_forward_pass_criteria.P1_sample: at least 100 trades AND entries in at least 40 distinct calendar months in the design window
walk_forward_pass_criteria.P2_net_edge_vs_C0: paired daily NET portfolio return difference (variant minus C0, design window) has a month-clustered bootstrap CI at alpha_per_test whose LOWER bound is above 0
walk_forward_pass_criteria.P3_consistency: variant net return exceeds C0 net return in at least 5 of the 8 yearly blocks
walk_forward_pass_criteria.P4_absolute: variant design-window net CAGR > 0 after the execution model

holdout_pass_criteria.O1: hold-out net Calmar >= C0 hold-out net Calmar
holdout_pass_criteria.O3: hold-out max drawdown no worse than C0's by more than 2 percentage points

risk_reduction_rule: V2-1 and V2-3 reduce risk by construction, so P2 (a proven return edge) may be too strict for them. They are ALSO judged on a registered risk route: max drawdown no worse than C0's, Calmar not lower than C0's, AND a real improvement in at least one of them (drawdown shallower by at least 1.0 percentage point, or Calmar higher by at least 0.05). Ties do not pass: a layer that changes almost nothing must not become a candidate. The same test applies to design and hold-out. This route was tightened on 2026-10-14 before any result existed (a synthetic-data test showed ties would pass).
adoption_rule: A passing variant becomes a CANDIDATE needing forward validation. C0 is never edited or replaced by this study.
